explanation: From Steep Point in the west to Cape Byron in the east, mainland Australia spans about 4,000 km. The Moon's diameter is only about 3,475 km.

claims.text: Mainland Australia's east-west extent is greater than the Moon's diameter.
Mainland Australia spans about 4,000 km from Steep Point in the west to Cape Byron in the east.
The Moon's mean diameter is about 3,475 km.

writerNotes: Self-check (§9.3). Lint: content:check run for the batch and writer; no errors or warnings on this item. Claims: every checkable statement is listed; c1 (number), c2 (number) and c3 (number) are high under the C26 floor. Datasets: natural-earth ne_50m_geography_regions_points, featurecla cape: Steep Point, geometry 113.145196, -26.157464, and Cape Byron, 153.627992, -28.661974, the westernmost and easternmost points of the mainland; the great-circle distance between them is about 3,987 km (c1, c2). The Moon is in no pinned dataset. Rival test: Argued for false: the Moon looks like a world and Australia like one country on a globe, so most people assume the Moon is bigger across. Mystery and encore: nothing of either kind to check in a practice item. External evidence: c3 needs a Tier A or B web result (NASA or a reference work). Seed: 4 (medium): many will answer false.
